name: TopAppBar
label: Top app bar
description: Mobile screen header with a menu or back button, title, and actions, in Rift, iOS, or Android style, collapsing on scroll.

props.name: title
props.description:
The screen's title.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which TopAppBar does not expose.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A second line under the title, e.g. a count or a date range

props.name: platform
props.description:
Which platform's bar to draw. `default` is the Rift bar; `ios` is the iOS
26 navigation bar, with glass circle buttons over content and a soft
blurred edge; `android` is the Material 3 Expressive top app bar.

props.name: size
props.description:
`small` puts the title in the bar. `medium` and `large` add an expanded
title under it that collapses into the bar as the page scrolls; on iOS
both are the large title.

props.name: align
props.description: Title alignment in the bar. Defaults to centred on iOS and to the start edge elsewhere

props.name: navigation
props.description: The leading control: a menu button, a back button, or a close button

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when the leading control is pressed

props.name: navigationLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the leading control; defaults to "Open menu", "Back" or "Close"

props.name: actions
props.description:
Trailing actions. The first three show as icon buttons; any more join the
overflow menu, ahead of `overflowActions`, where they render as plain rows
(a menu row draws no badge and routes from `onClick`, not `href`)

props.name: overflowActions
props.description: Actions listed in a menu behind a trailing "More" button

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the button that opens the overflow menu

props.name: badgeLabel
props.description:
The accessible name of an action that carries a `badge`, given the
action's `label`. Defaults to "<label>, new", e.g. "Notifications, new".

props.name: scrolled
props.description:
Whether content has scrolled under the bar, which collapses an expanded
title and switches the bar to its scrolled surface. Leave unset to have
the bar watch `scrollTarget` itself.

props.name: scrollTarget
props.description: The element whose scroll the bar watches when `scrolled` is unset. Defaults to the window

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Level of the title's heading element

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keeps the bar stuck to the top of its scroll container

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router. Wins over a LinkProvider's; a plain
`<a>` when neither is set.
